items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: But I had met Stan Getz before that

ctx.x: Right. Right, that was a great deal, and that's where I first heard the Four Brothers. But I had met Stan Getz before that, when he was living here in Hollywood, you know, and when I was playing at the Swing Club -- which I will go through a little later on.
In the meantime, things were going strong at Billy Berg's. And Howard McGhee came out here with Coleman
